You see a mine pump (sheared).
The pump's rod has sheared at the collar, and the old binding hangs in black strings. Water stands in the shaft below.
How to use: Stand beside it, press C and choose mend the mine pump for good, or patch it for now. The menu lists each material with how many you carry.
Needs: to mend it for good: 2 iron spike, 1 oak haft, 1 leather binding; to patch it for now: 2 fire clay.
Cost and limits: Mending uses up the materials and keeps any tool, and the repair lasts. A patch holds about 600 turns, then fails.
Right now you can: mend the mine pump for good, patch the mine pump for now.
